sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Amendment of Laws Act 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE
(AMENDMENT OF
LAWS) ACT, 1997
ACT I OF 1998
An Act to amend certain laws
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 12th January, 19981
PA/NWFP/Legis./98/1154, dated
12-1-1998.--The North-West Frontier
Province (Amendment of Laws) Bill, f997 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 23rd December,
1997 and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the
8th January, 1998 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature
of North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
(Amendment of Laws) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 1st July, 1997.

PA/NWFP/Legis./98/1154, dated
12-1-1998.--The North-West Frontier

Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 23rd December,
1997 and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the
8th January, 1998 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature
of North-West Frontier Province.
4. Amendment of N.-W.F.P. Act
X of 1977.--In the North-West Frontier Province Finance Act, 1977
(N.-W.F.P. Act X of 1977), in section 3, for subsection (1) the following shall
be substituted, namely:
"(1) For each financial year there shall be levied
and collected a tax on cinema payable by the proprietor thereof at the
following rates:
(i) in case of cinema classed as
a first class cinema; Rs.4,000 per annum
(ii)
in case of a cinema classed as a annum Rs.2,000
per second class
cinema; and
(iii) in case of a cinema classed
as a third class cinema Rs.500 per annum
Provided that the tax, at the
discretion of the proprietor of a cinema, may be deposited for three years at a
time, in advance, in which case the rate of tax for each three years shall be
Rs.10,000, Rs.5,000 and Rs.1,000 respectively.
